user.title: Sign in to MahaVidyut
user.description: Enter your MahaVidyut consumer number and app password. Your meter ID and phase are discovered automatically. Leave SMS verification off for the normal Maharashtra app login. Enable automatic sign-in to save your password in Home Assistant's local configuration and backups and recover expired sessions. This works only with password sign-in; leave SMS verification off.

otp.title: Verify your SMS code
otp.description: Enter the SMS code requested for this sign-in.

meter.title: Confirm meter details
meter.description: Sign-in succeeded, but MahaVidyut did not return all meter details. Enter your known internal MID and phase. Leave MID at 0 if unknown to use history and billing readings.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MahaVidyut. Try again when the service is available.
error.invalid_auth: MahaVidyut rejected the sign-in. Check your consumer number and password.
error.invalid_otp: The SMS code was rejected. Check the code and try again.
error.wrong_consumer: Sign in to the consumer number already configured for this meter.
error.invalid_response: MahaVidyut returned an unexpected response. The service protocol may have changed.
error.auto_reauth_requires_password: Automatic sign-in requires password login. Turn off SMS verification or automatic sign-in.

abort.already_configured: This consumer number is already configured
